_about: The starting sounds, in this order; the first is the one the phone page opens on (main.ts, docs/design/phase2-12-presets.md). Each names a full patch, presets/<patch>.vital, built by tools/build_presets.mjs. Vinny Bass 2 and Riddim Sub, the two the producer calls good (2026-10-02), then sixteen wobs in Vinny Bass 2's recipe: four rhythms (1/8, 1/8T, 1/4, 1/16) each dry, delayed, reverbed and with both (docs/design/phase4-05-riddim-recipe.md). The matcher's Sig Wob 1-5 and Ref Wob 1-6 and the earlier starting sounds are off the list - measured, the matched ones barely move (docs/design/phase4-05-riddim-recipe.md) - and stay in presets/ as a record.
